audit.whatIsWrong: QA lint pass: dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns
audit.why: matchup-lint reported MISGENDER / COPY_PASTE_BLEED / COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE / HEDGING on these fields; cooldowns and ranges taken from champ-data/_kits.
audit.corrected: Pronouns matched to the enemy champion; bled trade text replaced with field-specific advice; cooldown lines given real per-rank numbers.

edits.before: Q the last-hit from beyond his answer range, W the lateral dodge, and walk — a one-way trade he can only end by leaving the lane.
edits.after: Let him fire Arcanopulse first: at 9s early that is a long reload, and the mirror belongs to whoever still has a Q when the other is empty.

edits.before: Spending E on chip and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive on schedule — the stun is your only 'no' and everyone knows it.
edits.after: Opening with Rite of the Arcane roots you in place for the channel while his own 130s ultimate answers yours from the full 5000 range.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Shocking Orb has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Shocking Orb is 13s at rank 1 and 1050 range, and it is his only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. - Yours runs the same 13s, so whoever still holds it wins the standoff. - Both ultimates are 130s at rank 1: fire second.
